title: Make GLOBAL host-lock tests load resilient
body:
Replace time-based waits with condition waits bounded by deadlines in GLOBAL `test/host-lock.test.mjs` for the unflocked inherited descriptor, descendants keeping the lock, and nested run (status read right after spawn reports free under load 24–35; passes idle). Split from t-cx4gp1d, which covered the Product tests.
Acceptance: each test waits for its required condition with a deadline, uses no fixed sleep or elapsed-time assertion, and passes under concurrent load.
